sloka: समाश्वास्य तु सुग्रीवं राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः ।विद्रुतं वानरानीकं तत्समाश्वासयत् पुनः ।। ६.४६.४५ ।।।।
transliteration: samāśvāsya tu sugrīvaṁ rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।vidrutaṁ vānarānīkaṁ tatsamāśvāsayat punaḥ ।। 6.46.45 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Indrajith surrounded by all army entered the city of Lanka and approached his father.
